lines: Other delivered libraries: 24, axios 1.18.1, webdav 5.10.0, dompurify 3.4.13, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 0.28.0, focus-trap 8.2.2, semver 7.7.3, and 18 more.

107 delivered files carry no source map, 3 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
